summary: REQ-1 is not verifiably implemented based on the provided diff summary. The only substantive code change shown is to `frontend/src/index.css`, and the excerpt still defines a global `.app-container` gradient background and an `.initial-background-animation` layer, with no visible conditional styling tied to the post-Yes (celebration) state to remove/hide them.

missing_requirements.requirement: Remove the background from the post-Yes (celebration) screen so that after clicking the "Yes" button the celebration/section page does not show the app background/gradient, and the initial floating-particles background is not visible on the celebration screen, without regressing the pre-Yes screen background/animation.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary only shows CSS definitions (including `.app-container { background: linear-gradient(...) }` and `.initial-background-animation { position: fixed; ... }`) and does not show any new/updated state-based selector (e.g., a celebration-mode class on the container) or other mechanism that would disable the gradient and floating-particles background only on the celebration screen while preserving them on the initial screen.
